mainEntity.name: What is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for small businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) focuses on making your business's information easily discoverable and directly answerable by AI-powered search engines and voice assistants. Unlike traditional SEO, which aims for top search result rankings, AEO specifically structures content to be extracted and presented as direct answers. For small businesses, this means optimizing for featured snippets, 'People Also Ask' sections, and voice search queries, ensuring your services, hours, or contact information are readily available when customers ask a question directly to an AI.
acceptedAnswer.description: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) helps small businesses appear as direct answers in AI search engines and voice assistants, making their information easily discoverable.
